headline: Elite finishing inside eight feet and high-volume pull-up shooting defined Dončić's season.
strengths: From less than 8 feet, he converted 69.4% of his 441 attempts, finishing 9.6 percentage points above the league average on the same range.
From 24+ feet, he hit 38.4% across 739 attempts, which was 1.7 percentage points above the league average on that range.
watch: On 143 catch-and-shoot attempts, he converted only 36.4% of his field goals.
context: Pull-up jumpers comprised 61.0% of his shot selection, and 739 of his 1652 total field goal attempts came from 24+ feet. Defensively, 48.2% of his attempts came against open coverage at 4-6 feet and 36.4% against tight coverage at 2-4 feet. Over half of his attempts (53.7%) were taken in the middle of the shot clock between 15-7 seconds.
